prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Signing in securely saves your desktop pet to your cloud account so your pet is never lost.", "Cloud Save Protected"]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Your pet is ready to join your desktop. Let us show you how to control and interact with it.", "View Controls", "How to Interact with Your Pet", "Right-click your pet for actions, click and drag to move it, or press Ctrl+Pet to open voice chat.", "Right-click pet to access settings & sleep mode", "Drag and drop anywhere on your screens", "Click pet to start talking", "Finish Setup"]
2: ["Choose & Preview Your Companion", "Select a starter pet or upload custom photos with automatic validation preview.", "Select your starter desktop pet personality"]
3: ["Your Pet is Awakening!", "Play with your temporary desktop mascot while we prepare your custom pet shaders and AI models.", "Pro-tip: You can minimize your pet to the system tray anytime."]
4: ["Master Desktop Pet Commands", "Try these 3 quick actions so you know how to manage your pet on your desktop.", "Try right-clicking the pet icon", "Practice hiding your pet to the taskbar"]
5: ["Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "Pick how you want your new pet to fit into your daily desktop workflow.", "Interactive Friend vs Productivity Assistant"]
6: ["Having trouble signing in? Click here to check connection or retry authentication.", "Retry Sign-In Connection"]
7: ["Give Your New Companion a Name", "What would you like to call your desktop pet?", "Enter pet name...", "Confirm Name"]
8: ["Your pet stays conveniently accessible in your system tray anytime you need to hide or recall it.", "System Tray Enabled"]
9: ["Select Your Ideal Companion Experience", "Playful Pal (Interactive) or Chill Co-Worker (Background)"]
